name: Review Guardian - Fake Amazon Review Checker
description: Detect fake Amazon reviews with an A-F trust grade on every product page. On-device AI, no account - nothing leaves your browser.

content_scripts.//: Broad host match because Amazon's canonical product URLs put a slug BEFORE /dp/ (e.g. /Vented-Compact-.../dp/B0GR4P1KCH/...). Chrome MV3 match patterns require the path to literally start with /dp/, so narrow patterns like /dp/* miss those slug-prefixed URLs. We grant broad host access here and gate by URL inside content/amazon.js's isProductPage() (only /dp/, /gp/product/, /product-reviews/ paths run any real work). Verified against real amazon.co.uk product URL with slug prefix 2026-05-21.
